'''Sadus Vraal''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Xenobiologist/Legends|xenobiologist]] and [[Professor/Legends|professor]] working alongside [[Mola Haxtor]]. One of three leading [[rakghoul]] experts on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], he played a role in the discovery of the [[nekghoul]]s, a new [[Subspecies/Legends|subspecies]] capable of using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. He was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the fallen [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Ki Sazen]] for being unable to fix the [[Ultrawave Transmitter]].
